title: Lightdrift
excerpt: License-aware image search for AI agents. Search hosted Creative Commons images with provenance, license details, and attribution. Search with text, a reference image, or both.
content_html:
Give your agent images
it can actually use.

We do the sourcing, indexing, and maintenance. Your agent finds the image it needs.

Let your agent set it up

Choose your coding agent. Copy the prompt. Paste it into a chat.

Find it. Check the license.
Put it to work.

Give your agent image search through MCP or API, with file URLs, sources, and attribution details in every result.

Let your coding
agent set it up

Where
Lightdrift
fits in

Anywhere an agent needs the right image and the right to use it. One API call returns ranked image files with provenance, license details, and attribution requirements.

Simple, usage-based pricing.

Pay per search, not per seat. Start with free credit and only pay when your agents do. Add credit when you need it, with no subscription.

Pay as you go

For any team building with agents. Pay only for what you search.

$5/ 1,000 searches

  • Text, image uploads, image-plus-text and similar-image search
  • License details, provenance, and attribution on every result
  • Hosted Creative Commons images with license-aware results
  • Prepaid credit with optional auto-refill

Enterprise

Our highest tier, with custom limits for high-volume workloads.

Custom

Volume pricing

  • Volume discounts on every search
  • Custom rate limits and uptime SLAs
  • Dedicated support and onboarding
  • Security review and procurement
View limit tiers
